cases.description: The real-project lifecycle inside the REAL Starforge editor (Projects/Starforge/src/C05ProjectLifecycleSelfTest.cpp): NewProjectAt scaffolds a project; Commands::Create/AddComponent/SetField/TileEdit author a sprite, a painted tilemap, a canvas + button and a 2D light; a PNG asset is imported into project://textures and referenced; the F-CONTENT prefab (3D MeshRenderer + DirectionalLight blocks, an unknown FutureThing block, a child) is imported through the K13 drop path (InstantiatePrefab + RecordSpawn); SaveScene; CloseProject + OpenProjectPath reloads from disk with every entity found by UUID, every field intact, the 3D/unknown blocks verbatim and no stale link; PlayScene, 30 frames of runtime drift, StopScene restores the untouched edit scene; Commands::Destroy + Undo (same UUID/fields) + Redo + Undo, a SetField undo/redo; Commands::Destroy on the tilemap, SaveScene; the final file reloads inside the deadline. The wrapper then parses the saved scenes/Main.cscene OUT OF PROCESS against the expected table (present/absent ids, fields, parent links, verbatim 3D/unknown blocks, no duplicate ids).
